errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies "От всички" (Of all) as a time point. This is a summary or aggregate category, not a point in time like the other two categories.

The description incorrectly states that the x-axis categories are in chronological order. The category "От всички" (Of all) is a summary and does not fit into a chronological sequence with April and August 2021.
